create_pipeline_azure_dalle: create an Azure DALL-E manifold pipeline instance with configurable API key and endpoint
build_pipeline_models: build a list of available DALL-E models from semicolon-separated model IDs and names
run_image_generation: run Azure DALL-E image generation with a user prompt, model ID, and image size
test_valves_configuration: test the pipeline valves configuration with Azure OpenAI environment variables
review_pipeline_lifecycle: review the pipeline lifecycle methods for startup, shutdown, and valves update
